reviews.comment: I am a PhD student and strongly state that she is the best instructor I've ever had.  World Class on all levels.  Change your degree plan if you have to, take a class from her!  Yes, you will work hard but you will have fun doing it. Her practical exercises immediately amplify the value of the instruction. Real world applicability in every class.

As an older, experienced Phd student I strongly stated that Dr. Chambers is the best instructor that I have ever had the privilege to study under.  She is refreshingly authentic, respects everyone and consistently delivers world class instruction.  Change your degree plan if you have to and take a course from her, you will be well rewarded.

Passionate and caring, Dr. Chambers is deeply invested in her students and in their learning as she ties course concepts to real-life experiences. She is also understanding and willing to work with you so long as you are willing to put in the work to succeed in her class. The work is engaging and the lectures are insightful. Overall, she is great.

Bridgette is actually a CEO who teaches courses for Mays, and she is phenomenal. She cares deeply about the success of her students and gives incredible lectures. The only thing I wish we got more of was feedback on exams, but otherwise this was an amazing class. 10/10 would recommend.

Dr. Chambers is truly a one-of-a-kind professor! She loves what she does, and it shines through. She has so much wisdom, and I learned so much from her/this class. She truly cares about her students succeeding not just in college, but beyond. Class has a semester-long project and 2 exams. Definitely need to read book for exams. Amazing professor!

The best prof i have ever had in my life. No matter what grade you earn in this class, you learn so much. She cares about her students futures and gives amazing advice and offers it during class too. My only thing is that she does not give us the EXACT slides she uses until right before the exam, but still provides slides. Course long group project

One of the best Professors I've ever had, hands down. It's a privilege as a business student to be able to learn from Dr. Chambers. Not only does she care about her students inside and outside the classroom, but her wisdom and knowledge will stick with you throughout your career. She is the best!

Chambers was one of the best professors I have ever had at Texas A&M. Her lectures aren't boring at all and she always keeps you engaged. She genuinely cares for her students, i haven't met a professor like her. I really recommend her for the class because you will have a professor who is passionate and wants to see you succeed.

Great professor! She's nice, smart, and keeps the class interesting with real-world examples and practical advice. I loved that she challenged us—her semester-long project exposed me to areas like finance and strategy, which really pushed me to grow as an HR major. Highly recommend her course!
Very wise and cares for your well-being. Passionate and wants you to learn. Tests can be a lot of writing, but it's so she can see all you have learned

Dr. Chambers was an amazing professor, she is very knowledgeable and very personable, and she truly cares for her students. Lectures are very intriguing and thought provoking, its hard to not get pulled in and be interested in whats going on. 2 tests, 1 group project. As long as you attend class and activley listen you will do great.

Amazing teacher that genuinely cared about her students inside and outside the classroom. Offers extra credit, feedback on assignments, curve on exams, and attendance is not mandatory but helps a lot! I loved this class and enjoyed lecture, highly encourage taking her!
Very Helpful and cared for every student

Dr. Chambers is one of the highest achieving individuals that I've ever met. When she explains everything she does in a day, you will feel unaccomplished... but she genuinely wants to be there. Her lectures are engaging and very interesting, because she lived every topic she preaches to the class. One of the best professors at Mays hands-down.

She was honestly a really good prof who provided us with the material to learn. I had her for negotiations and regardless of what program you were in she provided support for us so that we could succeed. She also made sure her lectures were interesting and never threw any curveballs which was extremely relieving. She genuinely cares about students.
If you are coming from a non business major, you will struggle with this course and the instructor doesn't care about that.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Man, Dr. Chambers is such an amazing professor. She teaches some of the most valuable things that you can learn in college, and truly cares so much about her students!

My journey began with MGMT 637 in Dr. Chamber's classroom, and now, as I near the end of my program with MGMT 633, also taught by her, I can confidently say that her teaching has always brought new insights, shaping not only my student experience, but also influencing my life and career perspective. She treats us as professionals.

I really loved going to the lectures. Actively participating in the group assignments and the final pitch project helped us identify the problems faced by entrepreneurs and how to properly resolve them.
Professor Chambers is an entrepreneur herself, so its really fascinating how she connects the theoretical and practical words of entrepreneurship.

Dr. Chambers is one of the best professors I had during my time at A&M. She is very helpful when it comes to learning and is least worried about the grades. I almost got a B because of some technical difficulty while submitting an assignment but Dr. Chambers recognized the issue helped me maintain a 4.0. Respect!!!

Dr. Chambers is the best professor I have ever had. She genuinely cares for every student. For example, she says an encouraging comment and thanks each student individually for their effort as they hand in their exams. Her lectures are engaging; she appreciates when you speak in class, even if you are not 100% correct. 100% take this class.

Dr. Chambers is a professor that really cares for her students and wants them to succeed after college, and that is exactly what she tries to teach in her lectures. Her class consists of 3 exams and a few group days to work through case questions and prepare for a final presentation, which she grades relatively easily. Overall, great professor.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She cares so well for her students and fights for a future for them. You can tell teaching is her passion.

She is an impressive professor! With years of experience, she transmits valuable insights to her students in her lectures. She explains concepts clearly, is open to questions and feedback, and is very accessible to help her students. She provides valuable feedback and when she says she is there for you, she truly means it. Would take again!

Professors Chambers Foundations to Entrepreneurship course felt like real training on how to become a CEO. Her experience shows in her lectures and she is always willing to offer additional help. Textbook reading is required but an understanding of the concept is what's most important. Great Class! Would definitely take another one with this proff.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Chambers is very chill but still knows what she's talking about. You have to write a few papers and participate in weekly in-class mock negotiations with other students, but as long as you participate and show up to class, you'll probably get an A. I also absorb info better with her approach to teaching because I'm not stressed about exams.

Professor Chambers is a great professor. Throughout the semester she has provided us with many insights into her personal experience with change management. The assignments were very helpful and a good opportunity to apply the course concepts discussed in the lecture. Great professor - would definitely recommend!
Amazing professor! Would take her again! She helped me in so many different ways with advice and opportunities! Can't stress enough how much I liked this class!

Professor Chambers is Phenomenal! She gives meaningful readings and assignments and she truly does inspire her students to do well. Can be quite a bit of reading at times but she makes it all very meaningful, no busy work. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

I wish I had Professor Chambers for more classes. She is extremely knowledgeable and cares deeply about how you preform in class. There's 2 exams, group assignments and individual assignments. As long as you do the work and try on the assignments, there should be no reason why you shouldn't get an "A". Some extra credit is given periodically.
